notes: ACCESS: tier (a) HTTP only - curl_cffi (impersonate chrome120) for robots.txt, homepage HTML, collections.json (paginated, 393 published collections), collections/<handle>.json, collections/<handle>/products.json (paginated), and collection page HTML (hero H1 + embedded marmeto-collection-template data-section-settings JSON containing productCount). No block encountered; Playwright/Chrome not needed. robots.txt disallows /search and a few param patterns for User-agent:*, no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web entry at all - tier (c) not implicated. TREE METHOD: parsed the real desktop mega-menu + mobile menu-drawer embedded server-side in the homepage HTML (data-submenu=storage, id=link-storage) to get the authoritative Storage nav: Storage (top nav) -> Storage Type (submenu wrapper, itself just links to /collections/storage-type which duplicates the parent 'storage' collection and doubles as the drawer's 'View All' link - treated as the same aggregate node as Storage, not recorded as its own grouping row per the parent/View-All URL rule) -> three real leaf children: Storage Containers, Storage Jars, Extra Lids (page H1 = 'Storage Lids'). Cross-checked against collections.json (393 collections, keyword-scanned for storage/organiz/container/box/basket/jar/rack/shelf/tray/lunchbox/bottle terms) and the site's XML sitemap index (collections sitemap covers the same set as collections.json, no additional nodes). Also checked the footer 'Storage' SEO link list (oil-dispensers, small-glass-jars, glass-jars-with-wooden-lids, glass-spice-jars, tea-coffee-jars, klip-n-store-containers, spice-jars-oil-jars) and the Storage Jars collection's own filter tag vocabulary (Classic Storage Jars, Endura Airtight Jars, etc. appear only as data-product-tag filter facets inside that one collection, not as separate nav rungs) - both were link-spam/filter-facet artifacts (several footer entries point to the identical storage-jars URL under 3 different anchor texts) rather than genuine distinct category pages, so excluded per the View-All/filtered-listing exclusion rule; neither the Storage Containers nor Storage Jars collection page itself renders a visible subcategory chip strip. QTY METHOD: for each of the 3 leaves, cross-validated two independent counts that agreed exactly: (1) the theme's own embedded data-section-settings JSON 'productCount' field on the rendered collection page, and (2) manual pagination of collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250 counting unique product ids. Deliberately did NOT use the collections.json 'products_count' field (Storage=219, Storage Containers=409, Storage Jars=135, Storage Lids=6) since it is known-inflated per project history and disagreed with both cross-validated methods on every leaf. EXCLUDED: table-mats collection (H1 'Table Mats', products are 'Iris/Ivy/Grandeur/Kosmia/Starlight Premia Table Mats', product_type='Placemat', tagged 'Digital print'/'Premia'/'Tableware' - these are Borosil's melamine Premia dinnerware-line placemats, not fabric, so Kitchen & Dining not Textile). Full site-wide keyword scan of all 393 collection titles/handles for towel/apron/cushion/curtain/blanket/bedding/sheet/rug/napkin/linen/textile/fabric/throw/pillow/duvet returned zero matches - Borosil is a pure glassware/cookware/appliance (Wonderchef) brand with a small Home Decor line (vases, candles, diyas - decorative, not textile) and no home-textile category anywhere on the site, so textile_rows is empty, matching the brief's expectation. An earlier fetch of the homepage was contaminated by a filename collision with a concurrently-running worker in this same shared scratch directory (a stale 'home.html' briefly contained an unrelated Address Home / addresshome.com page with linen/cushion-cover/bedspread nav) - that data was fully discarded and re-fetched clean into SR-scoped filenames (ts235_*) before any classification was made; verified 'Borosil'/'myborosil' presence and absence of 'addresshome' in every file actually used for this output.
